subject: JIT access evidence + SCIM delta logs for SIG review
summary: Pioneer Health requested SCIM delta logs and evidence for Just-In-Time (JIT) access as part of their SIG review; thread covers artifact collection, log formatting, and a packaged delivery with attachments and Drive/Jira links.
messages:
From: Samira Khan <security@pioneerhealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: vendor-intake@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: JIT access evidence + SCIM delta logs for SIG review

Hannah,

Thanks for taking this. As part of Pioneer Health's SIG intake for the upcoming vendor review, we need a short evidence package focused on access provisioning and least-privilege controls. Can you provide the following by COB Mon (7/12):

- SCIM delta sync logs covering 6/01/2027 - 6/30/2027 (we need timestamped events, user id, operation, and error codes)
- A short diagram or sequence flow describing your JIT/gated-approval path for elevated roles
- A CSV mapping of privileged roles to permissions and a note on who can approve those elevations (internal titles acceptable)
- SAML metadata and confirmation of Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URLs in use
- A brief attestation that JIT access tokens/temporary roles expire automatically and the TTLs applied (or where that config is stored)

If you have a canonical Drive folder or a DocuSign attestation we can reference, include links. This request is primarily for SIG; we will cross-check against SOC 2 controls. Let me know if the timeline is tight.

Best,
Samira Khan
Security Intake | Pioneer Health
security@pioneerhealth.com

---
Note: we prefer zipped logs rather than raw CSVs for the initial package.
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <security@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: JIT access evidence + SCIM delta logs for SIG review

Samira — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver everything you asked for by COB Monday. Quick plan:

- Ben will extract the SCIM delta sync logs and redact PII where required (will include user IDs and internal UUIDs only).
- Neha will pull the privileged-role mapping and draft the approval matrix (who can approve, approver title, and escalation).
- I’ll export the SAML metadata and attach the JIT workflow diagram (high level) and an attestation statement describing TTLs and automatic revocation.

A couple of clarifying Qs before we package:
1) For SCIM, do you want the full PATCH/POST/DELETE payload, or just the control-plane events (create/update/delete + status)? We plan to include full event headers but can strip payloads if you prefer.
2) For the attestation, does Pioneer require a notarized signature or is a signed PDF from our security lead sufficient?

I’ll follow up with the artifacts once Ben and Neha upload them to a shared Drive folder.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: JIT access evidence + SCIM delta logs for SIG review

On Fri, Jul 9, 2027 at 10:05 AM hannah_schmitt@redwood.com wrote:
> Samira — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver everything you asked for by COB Monday.

Folks — I pulled the SCIM delta stream from our provisioning service for 2027-06-01 through 2027-06-30 and converted to a compact event schema for sharing:

Attached: scim_sync_logs_2027-06-30.zip (contains scim_events_2027-06.jsonl, error_summary_2027-06.csv)
Included fields in the JSONL: event_timestamp, user_uuid, scim_operation (POST/PATCH/DELETE), target_username, status_code, error_code, sync_window_id
Sanitized: replaced user.email and user.name with user_uuid and a hashed email token to avoid PHI transmission

I also included an error summary that shows 27 failed patches (mostly attribute mapping errors) with the sync_window_id for each. If Pioneer needs payload-level diffs for a subset of accounts, we can provide them under an NDA addendum.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Infra Engineer, Provisioning
Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <security@pioneerhealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: vendor-intake@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: JIT access evidence + SCIM delta logs for SIG review

Thanks Ben and team — that looks promising. A couple follow-ups:

- We need the mapping table that shows which SCIM attributes map to your internal role IDs. A redacted mapping (attribute name -> internal role ID) will be fine.
- For the JIT attestation: Pioneer Legal accepts signed PDFs from your Head of Security. Can you have that signed and uploaded to the Drive link?
- Please include the TTLs for temporary roles with timestamps and the mechanism that enforces expiry (e.g., short-lived JWTs, ephemeral credentials revoked by scheduler).

If you can add a short CSV of privileged-role membership snapshots (as-of 2027-07-08) with columns: role_id, role_name, current_members_count, approver_title — that will expedite our review.

Samira
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <security@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: JIT access evidence + SCIM delta logs for SIG review

Samira — delivered and packaged: see Drive folder and attached files. Summary of items uploaded to https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cJITEvidence

1) scim_sync_logs_2027-06-30.zip (attached) — JSONL event stream + error_summary_2027-06.csv (sanitized per our PII policy)
2) privileged-role-mapping_2027-07-08.csv (attached) — columns: role_id, role_name, permission_scope, approver_title
3) jit_access_workflow_diagram_v2.pdf (attached) — sequence diagram of request -> approval -> ephemeral provisioning -> audit
4) saml-metadata-redwood.xml (attached) — current as-of 2027-07-08; ACS endpoints and certificate thumbprints included
5) signed_attestation_jit_ttl.pdf (Drive link) — signed by Aisha Rahman, Head of Security (notes TTLs: ephemeral roles default to 4h; emergency elevation tokens default to 30m and require automated revoke)

Notes and caveats:
- SCIM events are sanitized; if Pioneer needs event payloads for specific accounts for troubleshooting, we can provide on a case-by-case basis under an amended DPA or controlled upload.
- The privileged-role CSV is a snapshot as-of 2027-07-08; we recommend using the approver_title column for human review rather than mapping to individual identities in your SIG assessment.
- We created a short Jira ticket SEC-4521 (https://pioneerhealth.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4521) to track any clarifications; please add comments there if you find anything missing.

Please confirm receipt and whether you need a notarized signature or additional logs (we can include 7/01–7/11 if required).

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
